title: Kissed Smoky Moroccan Vine Leaves Msemen
description: A smoky and flaky Moroccan dish featuring vine leaves, perfect for a date night, made with ovo-vegetarian friendly ingredients and cooked in a papillote.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion mixture, dates, and vine leaves.
Lay a piece of msemen dough flat and place a tablespoon of the onion and vine leaf mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Place the msemen in a papillote and brush the tops with beaten eggs.
Bake the msemen for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve the msemen hot and enjoy.
